rules.where: TRNS_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT T.TRNS_TYPE_CODE FROM ST_TRNS_TYPE T WHERE T.EFFECT = 1 AND T.TRNS_TYPE IN (1, 5) AND NVL(T.NO_COST, 0) = 0) AND ((NVL(DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0) OR (NVL(DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 1 AND OLD_TRNS_TYPE_CODE IS NOT NULL)) AND (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 OR STORE_CODE IN (SELECT DISTINCT ST.STORE_CODE FROM ST_STORE ST, ST_CHART_STRUCTURE CHRT, ST_STORE_PASSWORD SP WHERE STORE_STATUS = 1 AND SP.PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER AND SP.FLAG = 1 AND CHRT.CHR_STRU_LEVEL = (SELECT STORE_LEVEL FROM ST_STORE ST2 WHERE ST2.STORE_CODE = SP.STORE_CODE) AND CHR_TYPE = 1 AND SUBSTR(SP.STORE_CODE, 1, CHR_STRU_END) = SUBSTR(ST.STORE_CODE, 1, CHR_STRU_END))) AND (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 OR TRNS_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT TRNS_TYPE_CODE FROM ST_TRNSTYPE_PASSWORD WHERE FLAG = 1 AND PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) AND (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 OR SUPPLIER_CODE IS NULL OR (SUPPLIER_CODE >= (SELECT FROM_SUPPLIER_CODE FROM VN_SUPPLIER_PASSWORD WHERE PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) AND SUPPLIER_CODE <= (SELECT TO_SUPPLIER_CODE FROM VN_SUPPLIER_PASSWORD WHERE PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) AND (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 OR POSTING_SUPPLIER_CODE IS NULL OR (POSTING_SUPPLIER_CODE >= (SELECT FROM_SUPPLIER_CODE FROM VN_SUPPLIER_PASSWORD WHERE PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) AND POSTING_SUPPLIER_CODE <= (SELECT TO_SUPPLIER_CODE FROM VN_SUPPLIER_PASSWORD WHERE PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))

ST_TRNS_MAST.TRNS_TYPE_CODE.lov: select trns_type_code || ' - ' || desc_a d, trns_type_code r from st_trns_type where effect = 1 and trns_type in (1, 5) and nvl(no_cost, 0) = 0 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.flag = 1 and tp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

ST_TRNS_MAST.STORE_CODE.lov: select st.store_code || ' - ' || st.name_a d, st.store_code r from st_store st where nvl(st.store_status, 0) = 1 and nvl(st.stop_flag, 0) = 0 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or st.store_code in (select s2.store_code from st_store s2, st_chart_structure chrt, st_store_password sp where s2.store_status = 1 and sp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and sp.flag = 1 and chrt.chr_stru_level = (select s3.store_level from st_store s3 where s3.store_code = sp.store_code) and chrt.chr_type = 1 and substr(sp.store_code, 1, chrt.chr_stru_end) = substr(s2.store_code, 1, chrt.chr_stru_end))) order by 2

ST_TRNS_MAST.SUPPLIER_CODE.lov: select s.code || ' - ' || s.name_a d, s.code r from supplier s where nvl(s.supplier_status, 0) = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or (s.code >= (select max(from_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) and s.code <= (select max(to_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))) order by 2

ST_TRNS_MAST.ACCOUNT_NUMBER1.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || account_name d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or :G_COMPANY_CODE is null or account_number in (select p.account_number from ac_password_master p where p.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p.company_code = :G_COMPANY_CODE)) order by account_number

ST_TRNS_MAST.PURCH_CODE.lov: select code || ' - ' || name_a d, code r from vn_resp order by code

ST_TRNS_MAST.CUSTOMER_CODE.lov: select code || ' - ' || name_a d, code r from customer where nvl(stopflag, 0) = 0 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or (code >= (select max(from_customer_code) from ar_customer_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) and code <= (select max(to_customer_code) from ar_customer_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))) order by code

ST_TRNS_MAST.CNTRCT_SERIAL.lov: select a.serial || ' - ' || k.name_a || ' - ' || to_char(a.end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') d, a.serial r from st_supp_agrmnt a, supplier s, st_supp_agrmnt_supp p, st_good_kind k where p.supplier_code = s.code and a.serial = p.serial and a.kind_code = k.kind_code and s.code = :PAGE_SUPPLIER_CODE and nvl(s.stopflag, 0) = 0 order by 2

ST_TRNS_DET_EXPENS.SUPPLIER_CODE.lov: select code || ' - ' || name_a d, code r from supplier where (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or (code >= (select max(from_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) and code <= (select max(to_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))) order by code

ST_TRNS_DET.ITEM_CODE.lov: select t.item_code || ' - ' || nvl(t.name_a, t.name_e) d, t.item_code r from st_item t, st_item_unit u where t.item_group_code = u.group_code and t.item_code = u.item_code and nvl(u.basic_unit, 0) = 1 order by 2

ST_TRNS_DET.UNIT_CODE.lov: select u.unit_code || ' - ' || u.name_a || decode(iu.basic_unit, 1, ' (وحدة أساسية)', '') d, u.unit_code r from st_item_unit iu, st_unit u where iu.item_code = :PAGE_ITEM_CODE and (iu.group_code = :PAGE_GROUP_CODE or :PAGE_GROUP_CODE is null) and iu.unit_code = u.unit_code order by 2

ST_TRNS_DET.ITEM_NAME_A.sql: (select max(nvl(i.name_a, i.name_e)) from st_item i where i.item_code = t.item_code and i.item_group_code = t.group_code)
